lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple line segments exhibit termination before reaching the ventral mane; specifically, the second and third lines from the anterior terminate at approximately 60 percent of the torso height.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Ivory tipping constitutes approximately 18 percent of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the eyes, white facial spots on the cheeks, and a distinct white transverse band across the lower neck/chest interface.
